newsitem.title: INDIA: Israel president leaves after week-long India trip.
newsitem.headline: Israel president leaves after week-long India trip.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman has left India after a week-long trip aimed at boosting trade and economic ties, officials said on Sunday.
Weizman left on Saturday night from Bombay -- the final leg of his India tour -- where he invited the small Jewish community to migrate to Israel. There are about 5,500 Jews in India.
"Come to Israel," he told a gathering of Jews in Bombay. "I believe that the immigrants can live the life of a Jew... much better in Israel than in India."
Weizman, leading a team of 20 businessmen, met President Shankar Dayal Sharma and Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda among other political and business leaders.
India's first visit by an Israeli head of state triggered worries in neighbouring Pakistan, New Delhi's traditional foe, which has refused to establish ties with the Jewish state.
